steps.assert: document.querySelector('.ws').dataset.view === 'connect' || 'a route without a view should open in the connect view'
document.querySelector('.cn-timeline').getBoundingClientRect().width >= innerWidth - 40 || 'the timeline should take the full width'
document.querySelector('.connect-pane video')?.paused === false || 'the route should open playing'

(([r, g, b]) => r + g + b < 200)(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.cn-rate'), '::picker(select)').backgroundColor.match(/\d+/g).map(Number)) || 'the open list should be dark in the dark theme'
getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.cn-rate')).outlineStyle === 'none' || 'choosing a rate with the mouse leaves no focus ring'
document.querySelector('.cn-mute').disabled && document.querySelector('.cn-mute').title.includes('Record and Upload Microphone Audio') || 'a qcamera without sound says how to record it'
